note: P3975 (Pro 14:4) — where there are no oxen the manger is clean, but abundant crops come by the strength of the ox. (bar 'clean' = standalone.)

dims.v: strength — the ox's power that yields abundant crops
the strength/power of the ox by which abundant crops are produced
(the clean but empty manger, by contrast)
the productive strength set against sterile emptiness

koach (strength/power) — 'abundant crops come by the STRENGTH of the ox'; productive power is worth the mess it makes. The read hears the principle — an empty stall is tidy but fruitless; strength put to work, though costly, yields abundance. Emergent: strength/capacity as the productive good.
